Fixed rear-right three-quarter NE camera, faces upper-right away. No background/shadow/text. Ignore alpha-edge display colors. Keep equipment thin elegant segmented bamboo bow as reference2. Draw a genuinely new articulated walk pose:

SCREEN LEFT leg trails backward and supports the body on toes, heel raised with sole visible. Moderate stride just narrower than image1, right knee still slightly bent. This smoothly leads into image1 two frames later.
